info.title: Suannn API
info.description: Suannn API v1. Browser clients authenticate with Better Auth session cookies. Staff operations require an active staff session and the stated permission. List endpoints return { items, nextCursor }; pass nextCursor as cursor for the next page. Application route errors use { code, message }; Better Auth routes use their documented error responses. Responses include X-Request-ID.
